about: §308 P3 layering parity: one project, stacked by the editor preview (editor/src/video/preview/__tests__/layering-parity.test.tsx) and by sample_frame and the export (render/test/layering-parity.integration.test.mjs). Every layer but pip is full-canvas, so the centre pixel names the top layer. JSON order is deliberately NOT the editor's: an image-only track (plate) is listed below the footage track, and a video track (pip) above two image tracks; the editor stacks every video track first. expectTop is what is on top at the centre at each time, between every layer boundary.
